lessons: Premise is false: criteria 1-2 need tests/integration/test_retry_keeps_branch.py to run real git, but tests/integration/conftest.py guards every integration file not named in REAL_IO_TESTS (line 13), and conftest.py is outside the scope fence.

Re-author the ticket in one of two ways: add tests/integration/conftest.py to the fence and add test_retry_keeps_branch.py to REAL_IO_TESTS, or rewrite criteria 1-2 to drive prepare_worktree through the in-memory fakes in tests/fakes.py.

Put the real-git check of the new Git.worktree_attach in an allowlisted file such as tests/integration/test_git.py (it is in REAL_IO_TESTS) and fence that file. Test prepare_worktree's keep, rebase and fallback logic with a fake Git.

The Verification command names test_reconcile.py and test_kill_failure_suppression.py. Both are in DISK_IO_SKIP in tests/integration/conftest.py, so they are skipped and verify nothing. Drop them or name tests that actually run.
